summary: Harbor Point Payments will process card payments for Bluebird Bakery's shop in Columbus and supply one card terminal. The agreement runs for three years from the date Bluebird Bakery signs it, then renews by itself for a year at a time unless Bluebird Bakery gives written notice at least ninety days before the renewal date. Ending it before a term is over costs $495. Bluebird Bakery pays 2.9% of each card sale plus 30 cents per transaction, and Harbor Point can change any fee or add a new one at any time by email. Henry Alvarez, who owns Bluebird Bakery, personally guarantees all of its obligations. Bluebird Bakery covers Harbor Point for all losses, chargebacks and costs from its card transactions. Amounts paid more than ten days late carry a $25 late fee. Ohio law applies.
